    I am a researcher within the team “Modeling, Analysis and Simulation” of CERMICS at École des Ponts ParisTech.

    My CV

    I defended my PhD thesis on 11st February 2011 (manuscript). Title: Homogénéisation de modèles cinétiques dans des espaces de phase étendus. (Homogeneization of kinetic models in extended phase spaces) PhD supervisors: Claude Bardos and François Golse.

    Research interests:

    Partial Differential Equations, kinetic theory, applications to biology.

    Teaching:

    teaching at École nationale supérieure des sciences géographiques.
